description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify to confer the National Honours of Sri Lankabhimanya, Desamanya, Deshabandu etc., by the President
categorisation: This gazette content announces the conferral of national honors (Sri Lankabhimanya, Desamanya, Desabandu, Vidya Jyothi, Kala Keerthi, Sri Lanka Sikhamani) to various citizens for their contributions. This is an administrative matter involving state awards and recognitions, which does not fit any of the government structure/personnel categories (1-3) or the specialized categories (4-9). It is best classified as Miscellaneous.
